method: Built stdio server against an ephemeral synthetic loopback backend. Complete tools/list entries plus initialize instructions. No live endpoint, browser, user configuration or credential store.
tokenEstimateMethod: ceil(UTF-16 JavaScript string length / 4); heuristic, not a tokenizer or billed-token measurement. Byte counts use UTF-8.

initializeInstructions.text: You are sharing the user's real Chrome. Each MCP connection has its own enforced tab group, titled with TABZ_AGENT_LABEL over stdio or X-Tabz-Agent over HTTP when set. Call tabz_claude_group_status first. The first tab you open creates the group, and later browser actions reject tab IDs outside it. Leave the user's other tabs and other connections' groups alone. Close only tabs owned by this connection when done. Read compact page refs with tabz_read_page and use tabz_act for one action; refs expire after re-read, navigation, removal, or ownership change. tabz_batch runs enabled tools sequentially and stops at the first error. Never automatically replay an uncertain mutation. Filter console output by level and network output by URL pattern. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. On a login page call tabz_request_login and wait; the user signs in in their own browser. For a saved login use tabz_fill_secret; to add one use tabz_secret_request. Never read, list, or edit ~/.tabzchrome (the local saved-login store) with shell or file tools; the backend fills saved logins without disclosing them.

tools.name: tabz_docs
tools.description: Get full documentation for one tabz tool. Rule: your first opened tab creates an enforced group; outside tab IDs are refused. Leave the user's other tabs alone. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form.

tools.name: tabz_list_tabs
tools.description: List tabs. Rule: your first opened tab creates an enforced group; outside tab IDs are refused. Leave the user's other tabs alone.

tools.name: tabz_switch_tab
tools.description: Switch to a tab by ID, making it the default target for later page tools.

tools.name: tabz_close_tab
tools.description: Close owned tabs by ID, or close this connection's whole group. Tabs and groups outside this connection are refused. See tabz_docs("tabz_close_tab").

groupId.description: Close a whole group instead of naming tabIds.

tools.name: tabz_rename_tab
tools.description: Give a tab a custom name for this session, keyed by tab ID; an empty name clears it.

tabId.description: Chrome tab ID; omit for the current tab.

name.description: The name to assign; an empty string clears it.

tools.name: tabz_get_page_info
tools.description: Get the URL, title, and tab ID of one page; tabz_list_tabs covers your group.

tools.name: tabz_act
tools.description: Act on the page: one verb per call, from the action enum. Target by ref from tabz_read_page, CSS selector, visible text, or viewport x/y. Rule: never type a credential you asked for; tabz_fill SETS a form value with a read-back, tabz_fill_secret fills a saved login. See tabz_docs("tabz_act").

action.description: Page action, screenshot, cropped zoom, or local wait.

ref.description: Opaque target from the latest tabz_read_page for this tab.

x.description: Viewport x in CSS px, as measured on a screenshot; with y, the element there.

value.description: Text to append. Never pass a credential obtained from the user.

observe.description: Include the resulting viewport inline without saving it.

outputPath.description: Where to save it; a default path otherwise.

seconds.description: Local wait duration; wait action only.

trusted.description: true: real input via the debugger; shows the debugging bar, not chrome://.

tabId.description: Chrome tab ID; omit for the current tab.

waitTimeout.description: Maximum target wait for a page action, in milliseconds.

tools.name: tabz_batch
tools.description: Run enabled tabz calls sequentially in one round trip; stop on the first error. Cannot be nested. See tabz_docs("tabz_batch").

name.description: Enabled tabz tool name; tabz_batch is refused.

input.description: Arguments for that tool's strict schema.

items.description: Calls in execution order; stops on the first error.

tools.name: tabz_click
tools.description: LEGACY: prefer tabz_act. Click one element by CSS selector. See tabz_docs("tabz_click").

selector.description: CSS selector for the element to click (e.g., 'button.submit', '#login-btn', 'a[href="/home"]')

tabId.description: Target a specific tab by Chrome tab ID (from tabz_list_tabs). If not provided, uses the current tab.

tools.name: tabz_fill
tools.description: Set and verify a form value. Rule: submit only after "Fill Successful"; otherwise stop. Sensitive fields are never echoed back. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. See tabz_docs("tabz_fill").

value.description: Text to set. Checkbox/radio: boolean or true/false/on/off/1/0.

tabId.description: Chrome tab ID; omit for the current tab.

tools.name: tabz_request_login
tools.description: Hand a tab to the user to sign in, then wait briefly. Two clear probes show only that the prompt is absent, not proven authentication. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. During manual handoff, protection follows the tab across redirects while the user signs in and retains every protected document; after completion, the final document stays blocked through same-document SPA changes. A saved-field fill protects its exact document. The browser enforces this boundary across every MCP connection and browser agent: page content, scripts, screenshots, console, and network reads are blocked on protected documents. Submit only through a prepublished element reference already supplied by a tool response; when none is available, ask the user to submit or navigate. Arbitrary selector clicks are refused. After handoff completion or an ordinary saved-field fill, reads resume only on a fresh document navigation. See tabz_docs("tabz_request_login").

tabId.description: Tab showing the login page; your active tab by default.

url.description: Sign-in URL to open first, inside your group.

reason.description: One sentence shown to the user; never credentials.

timeoutMs.description: This call's wait; call again to keep waiting.

tools.name: tabz_secret_request
tools.description: Ask the user to save a login for a host, then wait briefly. Answers a status and the saved field NAMES, never a value; status deferred means an editor is already open, so ask the user to close it and call again. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. For a saved login use tabz_fill_secret; to add one use tabz_secret_request. Never read, list, or edit ~/.tabzchrome with shell or file tools. See tabz_docs("tabz_secret_request").

host.description: Hostname the login belongs to, e.g. 'app.example.com'.

reason.description: One sentence shown to the user; never credentials.

tools.name: tabz_secret_status
tools.description: Check whether a saved login is filled in yet. Read-only, so it is the safe poller for a pending tabz_secret_request. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. For a saved login use tabz_fill_secret; to add one use tabz_secret_request. Never read, list, or edit ~/.tabzchrome with shell or file tools. See tabz_docs("tabz_secret_status").

tools.name: tabz_fill_secret
tools.description: Fill a saved field without disclosing its value. Match by the tab hostname. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. For a saved login use tabz_fill_secret; to add one use tabz_secret_request. Never read, list, or edit ~/.tabzchrome with shell or file tools. During manual handoff, protection follows the tab across redirects while the user signs in and retains every protected document; after completion, the final document stays blocked through same-document SPA changes. A saved-field fill protects its exact document. The browser enforces this boundary across every MCP connection and browser agent: page content, scripts, screenshots, console, and network reads are blocked on protected documents. Submit only through a prepublished element reference already supplied by a tool response; when none is available, ask the user to submit or navigate. Arbitrary selector clicks are refused. After handoff completion or an ordinary saved-field fill, reads resume only on a fresh document navigation. Use the default synthetic fill first. trusted=true protects the whole tab until it closes, including fresh navigation. See tabz_docs("tabz_fill_secret").

selector.description: CSS selector of the input or select to fill.

tabId.description: Chrome tab ID; its hostname picks the entry.

host.description: Disambiguates when several entries match the tab.

trusted.description: Use trusted CDP typing only when the normal synthetic fill cannot work. This protects the whole tab until it closes, including every fresh navigation.

tools.name: tabz_screenshot
tools.description: LEGACY: prefer tabz_act action "screenshot". Capture the viewport or one element. See tabz_docs("tabz_screenshot").

selector.description: CSS selector for element to screenshot. If not provided, captures the current viewport.

outputPath.description: Custom output path for the screenshot. Default: Downloads/tabz/screenshots/screenshot-{timestamp}.png

tabId.description: Target a specific tab by Chrome tab ID (from tabz_list_tabs). If not provided, uses the current tab.

tools.name: tabz_screenshot_full
tools.description: LEGACY: prefer tabz_act action "screenshot" with fullPage. Capture the full page. See tabz_docs("tabz_screenshot_full").

outputPath.description: Custom output path for the screenshot. Default: Downloads/tabz/screenshots/screenshot-full-{timestamp}.png

tabId.description: Target a specific tab by Chrome tab ID (from tabz_list_tabs). If not provided, uses the current tab.

tools.name: tabz_download_image
tools.description: Download one image from the page, by CSS selector or direct URL.

outputPath.description: Where to save it; a default path otherwise.

tools.name: tabz_get_element
tools.description: Inspect one DOM element: HTML, computed styles, bounds, attributes. Run it before acting so you target a stable attribute.

styleProperties.description: Properties to extract; common ones by default.

tools.name: tabz_read_page
tools.description: Read a compact outline of visible interactive elements and get refs for tabz_act. A later read or navigation makes old refs stale. See tabz_docs("tabz_read_page").

tabId.description: Chrome tab ID; omit for the current tab.

maxChars.description: Maximum outline characters; truncated output says how to request more.

tools.name: tabz_open_url
tools.description: Open a URL; bare URLs use https, or http for localhost. Rule: your first opened tab creates an enforced group; outside tab IDs are refused. Leave the user's other tabs alone. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. See tabz_docs("tabz_open_url").

url.description: URL to open; the scheme is optional.

newTab.description: Open a new tab, or navigate the current one.

reuseExisting.description: Reuse a matching tab already in your group.

tabId.description: With newTab false, the tab to navigate (tabz_list_tabs).

groupId.description: Existing tab group for the opened tab.

addToClaudeGroup.description: Add it to your enforced group (default true).

tools.name: tabz_get_console_logs
tools.description: Read scoped console logs, newest first; omit level for warn+error. See tabz_docs("tabz_get_console_logs").

level.description: Level to keep; omit for the warn+error fast path.

tabId.description: Chrome tab ID; must be in your group. Omit for the group.

tools.name: tabz_execute_script
tools.description: Evaluate JavaScript through the debugger, or exact supported whitelist forms across all frames; returned values are bounded. Chrome may show its debugging bar. See tabz_docs("tabz_execute_script").

code.description: JavaScript to evaluate; the last expression's value returns.

allFrames.description: All frames, but only on the whitelist fallback path.

tools.name: tabz_enable_network_capture
tools.description: Start recording request metadata (no bodies) for a tab; read it with tabz_get_network_requests. Each call ADDS a tab, it never stops recording one.

includeSelf.description: Include the extension's own backend traffic.

tools.name: tabz_enable_deep_capture
tools.description: Start debugger capture for one tab: response bodies, server sent event messages, WebSocket frames. Rule: only one debugger owns a tab, so disable it when done. See tabz_docs("tabz_enable_deep_capture").

includeSelf.description: Include the extension's own backend traffic.

tools.name: tabz_disable_deep_capture
tools.description: Stop debugger capture for one tab, clear its deep rows, and release the debugger.

tools.name: tabz_get_network_requests
tools.description: List captured requests, newest first. Enable capture first. See tabz_docs("tabz_get_network_requests").

urlPattern.description: Keep URLs matching this regex; excludePattern drops them.

statusMin.description: Lowest status to keep, e.g. 400 for errors.

tools.name: tabz_get_response_body
tools.description: Read one deep-capture row's body, server sent event messages, or WebSocket frames, a page at a time.

requestId.description: Request ID from a deep row.

offset.description: Character offset into the body or message list.

tools.name: tabz_clear_network_requests
tools.description: Clear every captured request. Capture stays active.

tools.name: tabz_download_file
tools.description: Download a file through Chrome's download manager, answering the Windows and WSL paths.

filename.description: Filename under the Downloads folder; from the URL by default.

conflictAction.description: On a name clash: suffix, replace, or ask.

tools.name: tabz_get_downloads
tools.description: List recent Chrome downloads with status, size, and paths.

tools.name: tabz_cancel_download
tools.description: Cancel a download that is still running (IDs from tabz_get_downloads).

tools.name: tabz_save_page
tools.description: Save a tab as one MHTML file, a complete archive with its CSS, images, and scripts.

filename.description: Filename without extension; page title by default.

tools.name: tabz_get_bookmark_tree
tools.description: Browse the Chrome bookmarks tree.

folderId.description: Folder to list; omit for the whole tree.

tools.name: tabz_search_bookmarks
tools.description: Search bookmarks by title or URL, answering IDs the move and delete tools take.

tools.name: tabz_save_bookmark
tools.description: Save a URL as a Chrome bookmark.

tools.name: tabz_create_folder
tools.description: Create a bookmark folder, answering its ID for tabz_save_bookmark.

tools.name: tabz_move_bookmark
tools.description: Move a bookmark or folder into another folder.

tools.name: tabz_delete_bookmark
tools.description: Delete a bookmark or folder permanently; a folder takes its contents.

tools.name: tabz_get_dom_tree
tools.description: Get a page's DOM tree through the debugger: tags, ids, classes. Truncates below maxDepth levels (default 4, max 10), marking cut nodes with a child count. See tabz_docs("tabz_get_dom_tree").

maxDepth.description: Levels to descend; deeper is slower.

selector.description: Subtree to return; omit for the whole document.

tools.name: tabz_profile_performance
tools.description: Profile a page through the debugger: timing, memory, and DOM metrics.

tools.name: tabz_get_coverage
tools.description: Measure JS and CSS coverage, used against total bytes per file. Rule: it RELOADS the tab, so unsaved page state is lost.

tools.name: tabz_list_groups
tools.description: List every tab group with its title, colour, collapsed state, and member tab IDs.

tools.name: tabz_create_group
tools.description: Create a tab group from the named tabs.

tools.name: tabz_update_group
tools.description: Change a tab group's title, colour, or collapsed state.

tools.name: tabz_add_to_group
tools.description: Add tabs to an existing tab group.

tools.name: tabz_ungroup_tabs
tools.description: Remove tabs from their groups; Chrome deletes a group that empties.

tools.name: tabz_claude_group_add
tools.description: Add a tab to your own enforced group, creating the group with your label and colour if needed.

tools.name: tabz_claude_group_remove
tools.description: Remove a tab from your own enforced group.

tools.name: tabz_claude_group_status
tools.description: Get this connection's enforced tab group: exists, groupId, tabCount, tabIds. Call this first. Each connection has its own group; outside tabs are refused. Leave the user's tabs and other connections' groups alone. See tabz_docs("tabz_claude_group_status").

tools.name: tabz_list_windows
tools.description: List every Chrome window with its dimensions, state, and tab count.

tools.name: tabz_create_window
tools.description: Create a Chrome window; url "/sidepanel/sidepanel.html" gives a terminal popout.

tabId.description: Move this tab in instead of opening URLs.

tools.name: tabz_update_window
tools.description: Resize, move, focus, or restate a Chrome window (IDs from tabz_list_windows).

tools.name: tabz_close_window
tools.description: Close a Chrome window and ALL of its tabs (IDs from tabz_list_windows).

windowId.description: Window to close; all its tabs go with it.

tools.name: tabz_get_displays
tools.description: List the connected displays with dimensions, positions, and work areas.

tools.name: tabz_tile_windows
tools.description: Arrange the named windows side by side, stacked, or in a grid on one display.

layout.description: Side by side, stacked, or an automatic grid.

displayId.description: Display from tabz_get_displays; primary by default.

tools.name: tabz_popout_terminal
tools.description: Pop the terminal sidebar out into its own window; it shares the extension instance.

terminalId.description: Terminal to focus; omit to show all of them.

tools.name: tabz_speak
tools.description: Speak text with the configured browser voice. See tabz_docs("tabz_speak").

text.description: Text to speak; Markdown is stripped. Max 3000 characters.

voice.description: Voice name; configured voice by default.

priority.description: High interrupts; low may be skipped.

tools.name: tabz_list_voices
tools.description: List available text-to-speech voices. See tabz_docs("tabz_list_voices").

tools.name: tabz_play_audio
tools.description: Play an audio URL through the browser. See tabz_docs("tabz_play_audio").

volume.description: Volume from 0 to 1; configured default otherwise.

priority.description: High interrupts; low may be skipped.

tools.name: tabz_history_search
tools.description: Search the user's browsing history by keyword, over URLs and page titles.

query.description: Text to match in URLs and titles; empty matches all.

endTime.description: Range end, ms since epoch; now by default.

tools.name: tabz_history_visits
tools.description: Get one URL's visits: timestamps and navigation transitions.

tools.name: tabz_history_recent
tools.description: List the most recently visited pages, newest first.

tools.name: tabz_history_delete_url
tools.description: Delete one URL and all its visits from history. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: tabz_history_delete_range
tools.description: Delete all history in a time range. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: tabz_sessions_recently_closed
tools.description: List recently closed tabs and windows, with the sessionIds tabz_sessions_restore takes.

maxResults.description: Max sessions; Chrome caps this at 25.

tools.name: tabz_sessions_restore
tools.description: Restore a recently closed tab or window; omit sessionId for the most recent.

sessionId.description: Session ID; omit for the most recently closed one.

tools.name: tabz_sessions_devices
tools.description: List tabs open on the user's other synced Chrome devices; needs Chrome Sync.

tools.name: tabz_cookies_get
tools.description: Get one cookie by name and URL. Rule: the value is redacted unless you pass revealValue, and an auth-shaped name stays redacted. See tabz_docs("tabz_cookies_get").

revealValue.description: Show the real value; auth-shaped names stay redacted.

tools.name: tabz_cookies_list
tools.description: List cookies and their flags; pass domain or url to narrow it. Values come from tabz_cookies_get.

url.description: URL to filter by, path included.

secure.description: Keep only secure, or only insecure.

tools.name: tabz_cookies_set
tools.description: Create or update a cookie. Rule: changing one can break the user's session; the value is never echoed back. See tabz_docs("tabz_cookies_set").

domain.description: Domain; the URL host by default.

expirationDate.description: Seconds since epoch; omit for a session cookie.

tools.name: tabz_cookies_delete
tools.description: Delete one cookie. Deleting an auth cookie signs the user out.

tools.name: tabz_cookies_audit
tools.description: Audit one page's cookies: first or third party, session or persistent, trackers flagged. Values are never shown.

tools.name: tabz_emulate_device
tools.description: Emulate a mobile or tablet viewport through the debugger; reset with tabz_emulate_clear.

device.description: Device preset, or 'custom' with width and height.

mobile.description: Touch events and a mobile user agent.

tools.name: tabz_emulate_clear
tools.description: Clear every emulation override for a tab (viewport, geolocation, network, media, vision).

tools.name: tabz_emulate_geolocation
tools.description: Override coordinates and report actual Location permission; clear drops the override. Cannot grant permission.

tools.name: tabz_emulate_network
tools.description: Throttle the tab's network, by preset or by custom throughput and latency.

preset.description: Throttling preset, instead of the custom fields.

tools.name: tabz_emulate_media
tools.description: Emulate the CSS media type and features: print, color-scheme, reduced-motion, forced-colors.

tools.name: tabz_emulate_vision
tools.description: Simulate a vision deficiency for accessibility testing.

tools.name: tabz_notification_show
tools.description: Show a Chrome desktop notification and answer its notificationId.

buttons.description: Max 2; clicks are not handled yet.

tools.name: tabz_notification_update
tools.description: Update an existing notification's title, message, progress, or type.

type.description: Switch template, e.g. progress to basic when done.

tools.name: tabz_notification_clear
tools.description: Dismiss a notification by ID.

tools.name: tabz_notification_list
tools.description: List all active (undismissed) notifications.

tools.name: tabz_list_profiles
tools.description: List the saved terminal profiles, to find one before spawning.

tools.name: tabz_list_categories
tools.description: List the profile categories, for filtering tabz_list_profiles.

tools.name: tabz_spawn_profile
tools.description: Spawn a terminal from a saved profile (tabz_list_profiles to find one).

tools.name: tabz_get_profile
tools.description: Get every setting of one terminal profile.

tools.name: tabz_create_profile
tools.description: Create a terminal profile to spawn from later.

command.description: Command to run on start, e.g. 'claude'.

tools.name: tabz_update_profile
tools.description: Update a terminal profile; only the fields you pass change.

tools.name: tabz_delete_profile
tools.description: Delete a terminal profile permanently. Running terminals are unaffected.

tools.name: tabz_list_plugins
tools.description: List the installed Claude Code plugins by marketplace, with their enabled state.

enabled.description: Keep only enabled, or only disabled.

tools.name: tabz_list_skills
tools.description: List the skills available from enabled plugins; tabz_get_skill reads one in full.

search.description: Text to match in a skill's name or description.

tools.name: tabz_get_skill
tools.description: Read one plugin skill's whole SKILL.md, with its instructions and examples.

tools.name: tabz_plugins_health
tools.description: Check plugin health: outdated versions, cache size, marketplace reachability.

tools.name: tabz_toggle_plugin
tools.description: Enable or disable a plugin. Run /restart afterwards to apply it.

tools.name: tabz_list_terminals
tools.description: List the running terminals, with the IDs tabz_send_keys and tabz_capture_terminal take.

tools.name: tabz_send_keys
tools.description: Send text to a terminal through tmux; the 600ms pause before Enter suits Claude terminals.

execute.description: Press Enter afterwards; false just pastes.

delay.description: Ms before Enter; raise it for long prompts.

tools.name: tabz_capture_terminal
tools.description: Capture a terminal's recent output, truncated to the last `lines` of scrollback (default 50, max 1000).

ref.description: Opaque target from the latest tabz_read_page for this tab.

x.description: Viewport x in CSS px, as measured on a screenshot; with y, the element there.

value.description: Text to append. Never pass a credential obtained from the user.

observe.description: Include the resulting viewport inline without saving it.

outputPath.description: Where to save it; a default path otherwise.

seconds.description: Local wait duration; wait action only.

trusted.description: true: real input via the debugger; shows the debugging bar, not chrome://.

tabId.description: Chrome tab ID; omit for the current tab.

waitTimeout.description: Maximum target wait for a page action, in milliseconds.

tools.name: tabz_batch
tools.description: Run enabled tabz calls sequentially in one round trip; stop on the first error. Cannot be nested. See tabz_docs("tabz_batch").

name.description: Enabled tabz tool name; tabz_batch is refused.

input.description: Arguments for that tool's strict schema.

items.description: Calls in execution order; stops on the first error.

tools.name: tabz_fill
tools.description: Set and verify a form value. Rule: submit only after "Fill Successful"; otherwise stop. Sensitive fields are never echoed back. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. See tabz_docs("tabz_fill").

value.description: Text to set. Checkbox/radio: boolean or true/false/on/off/1/0.

tabId.description: Chrome tab ID; omit for the current tab.

tools.name: tabz_request_login
tools.description: Hand a tab to the user to sign in, then wait briefly. Two clear probes show only that the prompt is absent, not proven authentication. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. During manual handoff, protection follows the tab across redirects while the user signs in and retains every protected document; after completion, the final document stays blocked through same-document SPA changes. A saved-field fill protects its exact document. The browser enforces this boundary across every MCP connection and browser agent: page content, scripts, screenshots, console, and network reads are blocked on protected documents. Submit only through a prepublished element reference already supplied by a tool response; when none is available, ask the user to submit or navigate. Arbitrary selector clicks are refused. After handoff completion or an ordinary saved-field fill, reads resume only on a fresh document navigation. See tabz_docs("tabz_request_login").

tabId.description: Tab showing the login page; your active tab by default.

url.description: Sign-in URL to open first, inside your group.

reason.description: One sentence shown to the user; never credentials.

timeoutMs.description: This call's wait; call again to keep waiting.

tools.name: tabz_secret_request
tools.description: Ask the user to save a login for a host, then wait briefly. Answers a status and the saved field NAMES, never a value; status deferred means an editor is already open, so ask the user to close it and call again. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. For a saved login use tabz_fill_secret; to add one use tabz_secret_request. Never read, list, or edit ~/.tabzchrome with shell or file tools. See tabz_docs("tabz_secret_request").

host.description: Hostname the login belongs to, e.g. 'app.example.com'.

reason.description: One sentence shown to the user; never credentials.

tools.name: tabz_secret_status
tools.description: Check whether a saved login is filled in yet. Read-only, so it is the safe poller for a pending tabz_secret_request. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. For a saved login use tabz_fill_secret; to add one use tabz_secret_request. Never read, list, or edit ~/.tabzchrome with shell or file tools. See tabz_docs("tabz_secret_status").

tools.name: tabz_fill_secret
tools.description: Fill a saved field without disclosing its value. Match by the tab hostname. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. For a saved login use tabz_fill_secret; to add one use tabz_secret_request. Never read, list, or edit ~/.tabzchrome with shell or file tools. During manual handoff, protection follows the tab across redirects while the user signs in and retains every protected document; after completion, the final document stays blocked through same-document SPA changes. A saved-field fill protects its exact document. The browser enforces this boundary across every MCP connection and browser agent: page content, scripts, screenshots, console, and network reads are blocked on protected documents. Submit only through a prepublished element reference already supplied by a tool response; when none is available, ask the user to submit or navigate. Arbitrary selector clicks are refused. After handoff completion or an ordinary saved-field fill, reads resume only on a fresh document navigation. Use the default synthetic fill first. trusted=true protects the whole tab until it closes, including fresh navigation. See tabz_docs("tabz_fill_secret").

selector.description: CSS selector of the input or select to fill.

tabId.description: Chrome tab ID; its hostname picks the entry.

host.description: Disambiguates when several entries match the tab.

trusted.description: Use trusted CDP typing only when the normal synthetic fill cannot work. This protects the whole tab until it closes, including every fresh navigation.

tools.name: tabz_download_image
tools.description: Download one image from the page, by CSS selector or direct URL.

outputPath.description: Where to save it; a default path otherwise.

tools.name: tabz_get_element
tools.description: Inspect one DOM element: HTML, computed styles, bounds, attributes. Run it before acting so you target a stable attribute.

styleProperties.description: Properties to extract; common ones by default.

tools.name: tabz_read_page
tools.description: Read a compact outline of visible interactive elements and get refs for tabz_act. A later read or navigation makes old refs stale. See tabz_docs("tabz_read_page").

tabId.description: Chrome tab ID; omit for the current tab.

maxChars.description: Maximum outline characters; truncated output says how to request more.

tools.name: tabz_open_url
tools.description: Open a URL; bare URLs use https, or http for localhost. Rule: your first opened tab creates an enforced group; outside tab IDs are refused. Leave the user's other tabs alone. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. See tabz_docs("tabz_open_url").

url.description: URL to open; the scheme is optional.

newTab.description: Open a new tab, or navigate the current one.

reuseExisting.description: Reuse a matching tab already in your group.

tabId.description: With newTab false, the tab to navigate (tabz_list_tabs).

groupId.description: Existing tab group for the opened tab.

addToClaudeGroup.description: Add it to your enforced group (default true).

tools.name: tabz_get_console_logs
tools.description: Read scoped console logs, newest first; omit level for warn+error. See tabz_docs("tabz_get_console_logs").

level.description: Level to keep; omit for the warn+error fast path.

tabId.description: Chrome tab ID; must be in your group. Omit for the group.

tools.name: tabz_execute_script
tools.description: Evaluate JavaScript through the debugger, or exact supported whitelist forms across all frames; returned values are bounded. Chrome may show its debugging bar. See tabz_docs("tabz_execute_script").

code.description: JavaScript to evaluate; the last expression's value returns.

allFrames.description: All frames, but only on the whitelist fallback path.

tools.name: tabz_claude_group_status
tools.description: Get this connection's enforced tab group: exists, groupId, tabCount, tabIds. Call this first. Each connection has its own group; outside tabs are refused. Leave the user's tabs and other connections' groups alone. See tabz_docs("tabz_claude_group_status").
